description: Resource-Based Constrained Delegation: principal can act on behalf of others to the target computer.

telemetry.detail: Write to msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity on the target computer - logged under DS-change auditing (default OFF).
S4U2proxy TGS requests to the target during abuse.
The RBCD attribute write plus S4U pattern is a recognised chain in ITDR tooling.

prerequisite_privilege: GenericWrite/GenericAll over the target computer object to set the RBCD attribute
abuse_primitive: Write msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity to a controlled computer/account, then S4U to the target as admin.
notes: One directory write (quiet without auditing) plus Kerberos S4U. Popular because the setup is low-signal in default configs.
